method.cpu_limit: Windows CPU accounting is quantized; no CPU reduction, power or stable tail claim
method.desktop: input isolated, no user input, original hardware confirm_active_presentation; receipt is submit/present evidence, not scanout or GPU completion
method.frame: two explicit public Frame calls advance the original FrameExecutionStart sequence (exactly one in quiescent headless), preserve engine/logical ticks and complete canonical state; no synthetic service counter
method.gain_scope: aggregate child idle inbox-check reduction; unchanged 10 ms parent response polling prevents an inferred end-to-end latency gain
method.latency_window: public Host call entry through its returned original Result after startup; startup and gameplay preparation are separately excluded
method.scope: finite cooperative acceptance on this idle Windows desktop; synchronous callbacks, drivers and native calls are not interruptible hard real-time deadlines
method.state: exact encode_resume bytes across idle and explicit paused maintenance; one ordinary Step must advance exactly one logical tick
method.variant_difference: one exact IDLE_RECONCILE_INTERVAL constant in each owned copied continuity.rs; both use actual native notify watchers
